manager.release_notes: PluggedIN Central v3.0.7 - Full 19-Plugin Studio Ecosystem featuring PlugCords Guitar & Bass Suite (v1.1.0), PlugAmp 4x Oversampled Tube Reactor (v1.1.0), PlugKnock 16-Pad Drum Engine (v1.1.0), and PlugGrand Workstation (v1.1.0).

plugins.name: PLUGGED 1
plugins.subtitle: Flagship Multi-Voice Hybrid Synthesizer
plugins.description: Flagship polyphonic multi-engine synthesizer and phase-locked 808 workstation featuring 3-stage Bezier pitch punch, anti-click legato glide, dynamic sub-harmonic tracking, and studio-grade FX rack.
features: Phase-locked Sub-808 engine with 3-stage Bezier transient punch & dynamic sub-harmonic tracking
Zero-click legato portamento & multi-voice wavetable/analog oscillators
Zero-delay feedback state-variable filter & integrated studio FX rack
Interactive 3D hardware faceplate & real-time visualizer

plugins.name: PLUGTNE
plugins.subtitle: Real-Time AutoTune & Formant Correction Suite
plugins.description: Ultra-low latency real-time vocal pitch correction, formant shifting, and throat modeling suite engineered for modern tracking and mixing.
features: Zero-latency tracking mode for live vocal recording
Independent formant preservation & throat length modeling
Scale/Key lock with real-time pitch ring telemetry
Natural humanize & vibrato sculpting

plugins.name: UNDERGRND
plugins.subtitle: Analog Heat & Multi-Stage Distortion Processor
plugins.description: Multi-stage analog harmonic saturator, wavefolder, and sub-bass exciter built for heavy 808s, aggressive drums, and gritty synth buses.
features: Multi-circuit tube, tape, and transformer saturation
Dedicated low-end phase lock & 808 sub reinforcement
Pre/Post tilt tone shaping with dry/wet parallel mix
Oversampled anti-aliased clipping stages

plugins.name: PLUGVOX
plugins.subtitle: Real-Time Vocal Doubler & Stereo Harmonic Processor
plugins.description: Studio vocal chain processor combining micro-pitch stereo doubling, optical leveling, air exciter, and spatial dimension in one console.
features: Phase-coherent stereo vocal widening & micro-shift
Harmonic air shelf for instant top-end vocal sheen
Integrated vocal gate and de-harshing filter
Zero-latency studio monitoring path

plugins.name: PLUGOPTO
plugins.subtitle: Warm Optical Vocal & Bass Leveler
plugins.description: Classic electro-optical leveling amplifier modeled with program-dependent two-stage release and warm tube makeup gain.
features: Authentic T4B optical cell memory & two-stage release
Warm tube output stage harmonic coloration
Sidechain high-pass emphasis filter
Precision VU gain reduction metering

plugins.name: PLUGGLUE
plugins.subtitle: Master Bus VCA Glue Compressor
plugins.description: British console master bus VCA compressor engineered to bind drums, instruments, and full mixes together with punch and authority.
features: Classic stepped attack, release, and ratio topology
Parallel Mix knob for effortless New York compression
Sidechain high-pass filter to protect low-end sub weight
Switchable soft-clip output limiter

plugins.name: PLUG EQ
plugins.subtitle: Pro-Q 3 Studio Precision 24-Band Dynamic EQ
plugins.description: Flagship 24-band dynamic parametric equalizer featuring Nyquist-decamped Pro-Q 3 filter math, 9 filter shapes, 6dB-96dB/oct + Brickwall slopes, real-time pre/post FFT analyzer, and floating 3-knob wing HUD.
features: Up to 24 dynamic bands with Bell, Low/High Cut, Shelf, Notch, BandPass, Tilt & Flat-Tilt
Calibrated Q=1.00 Butterworth reference & Nyquist bandwidth de-cramping across all slopes (6-96 dB/oct + Brickwall)
Per-band Stereo, Left, Right, Mid, and Side routing with Alt+Click momentary band Solo sweep
Floating Pro-Q 3 3-Knob Wing HUD with musical note readout, Auto-Gain, Phase Flip, and Full Undo/Redo

plugins.name: PLUGLIMIT
plugins.subtitle: True Peak Precision Mastering Limiter
plugins.description: Transparent lookahead brickwall mastering limiter with inter-sample True Peak ceiling protection and LUFS loudness telemetry.
features: Lookahead transient preservation stage
True Peak ceiling lock (-3.0 dB to 0.0 dB)
Real-time gain reduction & LUFS loudness metering
Unity Gain audition mode for level-matched A/B checks

plugins.name: PLUGDELAY
plugins.subtitle: Stereo Tape & Ping-Pong Echo Processor
plugins.description: Host-synced stereo delay and analog tape echo processor with built-in ducking, feedback filtering, and tape wow/flutter modulation.
features: BPM-synced straight, dotted, and triplet subdivisions
Built-in dynamic ducking to keep lead vocals upfront
High-cut and low-cut feedback loop sculpting
True stereo and wide ping-pong bounce modes

plugins.name: PLUGVERB
plugins.subtitle: Algorithmic Lush Space & Plate Reverb
plugins.description: High-density algorithmic studio reverb featuring vintage plate, concert hall, shimmer chamber, and modulated cloud spaces.
features: Ultra-dense diffusion network with zero metallic ringing
Pre-delay, high/low damping, and stereo width controls
Built-in vocal ducker for clean reverb tails
Instant freeze & infinite pad sustain mode

plugins.name: PLUGRACK
plugins.subtitle: Multi-FX Modular Channel Strip
plugins.description: Modular 500-series style studio channel strip combining preamp drive, gate, compressor, musical EQ, and output limiter.
features: Drag-and-drop modular signal chain routing
Harmonic console preamp saturation stage
Fast FET/VCA compression & musical 3-band EQ
Zero-latency tracking and mixing operation

plugins.name: PLUGCHOP
plugins.subtitle: Rhythmic Stutter, Gross Time & Gate Sequencer
plugins.description: Tempo-synced time manipulator, rhythmic trance gate, tape-stop, halftime, and glitch buffer sequencer.
features: 36 instant rhythmic time-manipulation & gate banks
Click-free de-clicked envelope smoothing
Independent Time Mix and Gate Mix macro dials
Sample-accurate DAW bar position synchronization

plugins.name: PLUGSILKY
plugins.subtitle: Silky High-End Air & Presence Exciter
plugins.description: Dynamic harmonic air exciter and harshness tamer that adds expensive studio sheen to vocals, acoustic instruments, and master buses.
features: Dynamic resonance suppression in the 2.5kHz-8kHz harshness zone
Harmonic air synthesis above 10kHz without sibilance
Tube warmth & stereo shimmer widening
Real-time spectral delta auditioning

plugins.name: PLUGBLUE
plugins.subtitle: Aggressive Fast FET Drum & Vocal Punch Compressor
plugins.description: Ultra-fast Blue Stripe FET limiting amplifier modeled for explosive vocal presence, aggressive drum room smash, and gritty bass lock.
features: 20-microsecond ultra-fast FET attack response
Classic 4:1, 8:1, 12:1, 20:1, and All-Buttons-In nuke mode
Input/Output transformer harmonic saturation
Built-in parallel wet/dry blend

plugins.name: PLUGWARP
plugins.subtitle: Tape Saturation & Harmonic Pitch Modulation
plugins.description: Vintage reel-to-reel tape warble, VHS drift, analog chorus, and lo-fi harmonic coloration processor.
features: Dual-oscillator organic wow and flutter pitch drift
Magnetic tape hysteresis & head-bump saturation
Adjustable vinyl dust, mechanical hum, and age wear
Stereo width & lush dimensional chorus

plugins.name: PLUGAMP
plugins.subtitle: High-Voltage Tube Reactor & Dual-Mic Studio Console
plugins.description: High-voltage 4x oversampled tube amplifier reactor, overdrive pedal bay, interactive dual-mic 4x12/2x12 cabinet stage, and Hermite quad-track studio finisher rack built for rock, pop-punk, trap-metal, and R&B guitar & bass production.
features: 4x oversampled asymmetric 12AX7/EL34 tube cascade with dynamic power-amp sag
4 Pre-Amp Drive circuits (Pure DI, Green 808, Gold Drive, Velvet Fuzz) with ultra-fast noise gate
Interactive 2D Speaker Cone Mic Placement with 5 studio cabinet models & Hermite Quad-Track doubler
24 mix-ready artist-inspired presets with tight studio room ambience

plugins.name: PLUGKNOCK
plugins.subtitle: Studio Drum Designer & Mix-Flare Engine
plugins.description: Hard-hitting studio drum workstation and Mix-Flare transient engine loaded with 46 acoustic, trap, 808 & West Coast/stadium stomp models, multi-velocity round-robin articulation, and 2x oversampled bus clipping.
features: 46 multi-velocity studio drum, 808 & stomp models (including 10 West Coast, Stadium & Timber Stomps) with 4-way round-robin micro-variation
6 Hero Mix-Flare controls: Smack, Clip, Body, Tight, Layer, and Flare Room
Authentic hi-hat choke groups, Bezier kick transient punch, and Pultec low-end sculpting
4 Mix Target Modes (Trap Knock, Live Rock Punch, Radio Pop Crisp, Lo-Fi Dusty)

plugins.name: PLUGGRAND
plugins.subtitle: Multi-Zone Pianos, Keys, Brass & Orchestra Workstation
plugins.description: Concert grand piano, intimate felt piano, vintage electric keys, orchestral strings, and brass workstation engineered for cinematic and modern production.
features: 14 multi-zone acoustic grand, felt piano, vintage keys, strings & brass instruments
4-layer hybrid engine combining Multi-Zone Sample ROM + Physical Modeling Keys, Brass & Mallets
5 Hero Acoustic Controls: Tone/Felt, Hammer Mechanics, Vintage Lo-Fi, Stereo Width & Concert Hall
88-key interactive keyboard with zero-aliasing interpolation

plugins.name: PLUGCORDS
plugins.subtitle: Studio Electric, Acoustic & Bass Guitar Workstation
plugins.description: Playable studio electric, acoustic, and bass guitar instrument workstation with 11 multi-zone models, hybrid Karplus-Strong string physics, humanized chord strumming, and built-in 4x12 / 8x10 Ampeg-style amp & cabinet rig.
features: 11 Studio Guitar & Bass Models including Overdrive Stack, Clean Single-Coil, Acoustic Dreadnought, Nylon, Fingered P-Bass, Picked Punk Bass & Sub Bass
41 genre-ready presets across Pop-Punk, Metal, Trap/Emo, Clean/R&B, Acoustic, and Studio Bass
Humanized strum engine, power-chord generator, velocity palm-muting & fret-slide expression
Built-in 2x oversampled Tube Amp, 4x12 Guitar Cab, 8x10 SVT Bass Cab & Stereo Haas Doubler
